senses.definition: Lacking kindness, sympathy, benevolence, gratitude, or similar; cruel, harsh or unjust; ungrateful.
Not kind; contrary to nature or type; unnatural.
senses.example: […] A Feauer is an vnkinde heate, that commeth out of the heart, and passeth into all the members of the bodye, and grieueth the working of the bodye.

senses.definition: Having no race or kindred; childless.
senses.example:
O, had thy mother borne so hard a mind,
She had not brought forth thee, but died unkind.
